messages.author: 0bc357a2b8347256
messages.subject: Multiple Inputs Sharing an input variable name?
parts:
I've got a UI function that looks like the code below.  I thought I could save a lot of headache in my server.r function by having conditional panels set input variables to different values (i.e. one conditional panel sets selectInput("x"....) to a series of values and another conditional panel may set selectInput("x" ...) to something different as shown below.

The problem I'm running into is that this does not work.  It just sets "x" to whatever the original value is.  Is there a better way to do this, or do I just have to create separate input variables for each and every case?

conditionalPanel(
                    condition = "input.selectedPanel == 'Purchase Metrics'",
                    selectInput("inputGranularity", "Select Date Granularity:", granularities),
                    selectInput("inputMetric", "Select Metric:", purchaseMetrics)
                ),
                conditionalPanel(
                    condition = "input.selectedPanel == 'Traffic Metrics'",
                    selectInput("inputGranularity", "Select Date Granularity:", granularities),
                    selectInput("inputMetric", "Select Metric:", trafficMetrics)
                ),
                conditionalPanel(
                    condition = "input.selectedPanel == 'Content Metrics'",
                    selectInput("inputGranularity", "Select Date Granularity:", granularitiesShort),
                    selectInput("inputMetric", "Select Metric:", contentMetrics)
                    #uiOutput("selectedElementInput")
                ),
                conditionalPanel(
                    condition = "input.selectedPanel == 'Campaign Metrics'",
                    selectInput("inputGranularity", "Select Date Granularity:", granularitiesShort),
                    selectInput("inputMetric", "Select Metric:", campaignMetrics),
                    selectInput("inputClassification", "Select Classification:", campaignClassifications)
                    #uiOutput("selectedElementInput")
                ),
                conditionalPanel(
                    condition = "input.selectedPanel == 'Product Metrics'",
                    selectInput("inputGranularity", "Select Date Granularity:", granularitiesShort),
                    selectInput("inputMetric", "Select Metric:", productMetrics),
                    selectInput("inputClassification", "Select Classification:", productClassifications)
                    #uiOutput("selectedElementInput")
                )
)

messages.subject: Re: Multiple Inputs Sharing an input variable name?
parts:
There can only be one input with a given name, even if the others are hidden (I think). You'll want to use dynamic UI here, for example:
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winstontest/dynamic_ui/
